context_budget.interpretation: A drift guard for progressive disclosure, not a semantic-completeness or owner-acceptance claim.

always_discovered.consumer: Codex skill discovery and package selection
always_discovered.load_moment: before a trigger; description is the selection signal
always_discovered.freshness: frontmatter identity/description and activation metadata parity
always_discovered.next_organ: selected skill body or the nearest owner route

triggered_body.consumer: the agent after a skill trigger
triggered_body.canonical_owner: aoa-skills skill source; local package preserves the exported contract
triggered_body.freshness: package digest and source metadata are current in the generated read model
triggered_body.next_organ: the skill's named owner, validator, or refusal/return route

on_demand_reference.consumer: a triggered task that needs a schema, rationale, or boundary detail
on_demand_reference.canonical_owner: the source skill package and its AoA source owner
on_demand_reference.freshness: resolved local route and package digest
on_demand_reference.next_organ: return to the triggered body; hand schema authority to its named owner

on_demand_example.consumer: a triggered task needing a worked shape
on_demand_example.canonical_owner: the source skill package and its AoA source owner
on_demand_example.freshness: resolved local route and package digest
on_demand_example.next_organ: apply only the example's bounded shape, then use the owner contract

review_check.consumer: human or agent review of a skill-shaped result
review_check.load_moment: on demand after the result exists
review_check.canonical_owner: the skill source owner; checks do not replace owner review
review_check.next_organ: named owner review or validation lane

executable_helper.consumer: a task that explicitly needs a local helper
executable_helper.freshness: resolved executable route; advisory unless a separate lane promotes it
executable_helper.next_organ: the helper's declared contract and the owner validation lane

portable_asset.canonical_owner: the source skill package; portable copies are not local doctrine
portable_asset.next_organ: the package source owner for changes

engineering_core.consumer: Tree-of-Sophia contributors and coding agents handling source, docs, contracts, boundaries, and tests
engineering_core.load_moment: description for selection, SKILL.md after trigger, references/examples only when the bounded task needs them
engineering_core.canonical_owner: 8Dionysus/aoa-skills; repository owner remains the named local source, docs, mechanics, or test organ
engineering_core.freshness: local package metadata, companion routes, and generated package digests; source-owner refresh is a separate upstream event
engineering_core.next_organ: nearest local owner contract and its narrow validator/test, or the stronger AoA owner named by the route
negative_controls: Do not use an ADR to resolve source-of-truth ambiguity.
Do not let a generated export, validator, or package map replace an authored owner.

risk_controls.consumer: agents handling mutation, deployment, runtime, infrastructure, or public-sharing pressure
risk_controls.load_moment: description for selection, SKILL.md after a risk trigger, scripts/references only for the chosen bounded control
risk_controls.canonical_owner: 8Dionysus/aoa-skills for the skill contract; approval, runtime, infrastructure, and public-sharing owners retain their own authority
risk_controls.freshness: local package metadata and route parity; live status, operator evidence, and receipts are external carriers
risk_controls.next_organ: approval or dry-run carrier, named runtime/infrastructure owner, or sanitized sharing surface; return without fabricating success
negative_controls: A dry-run is not authorization and an approval classification is not a preview.
Do not put secrets, host paths, transient status, or operator evidence in public authored docs.

session_growth.consumer: reviewed AoA session and closeout flows that need bounded next routes or growth candidates
session_growth.load_moment: description for selection, SKILL.md after a reviewed-session trigger, references/examples for the named packet shape
session_growth.canonical_owner: 8Dionysus/aoa-skills for the portable skill; reviewed session, memory, eval, quest, routing, and playbook owners retain their own records
session_growth.freshness: local package metadata and route parity; no live session snapshot or progression state is authored here
session_growth.next_organ: reviewed session artifact -> named AoA owner skill/port -> owner validation and explicit return
negative_controls: Do not diagnose or repair a live or unreviewed session.
Do not turn a candidate, checkpoint hint, or skill result into a verdict, authority grant, or durable memory by implication.

eval_port.consumer: eval pressure intake and local-port validation before central eval selection or verdict
eval_port.load_moment: when a repository task produces or asks for eval pressure
eval_port.freshness: local route and PORT.yaml; central validator/source checkout determines shared protocol compatibility
eval_port.next_organ: aoa-evals local port validator, then central selection/proof/verdict owner

stats_port.consumer: owner-local measurement readers and aoa-stats composition
stats_port.load_moment: when a declared Tree-of-Sophia question needs a measurement or reference packet
stats_port.canonical_owner: 8Dionysus/aoa-stats for shared grammar; Tree-of-Sophia for the question and source population
stats_port.freshness: manifest, source population, route map, and evidence-linked reference packet at a named revision; reference-only, not live
stats_port.next_organ: atlas/source owner -> aoa-stats protocol validator and cross-owner composition

kag_provider.consumer: aoa-kag registry/composition, abyss-stack federation, and MCP resources
kag_provider.load_moment: when a downstream consumer requests the portable ToS provider family or its currentness
kag_provider.canonical_owner: 8Dionysus/aoa-kag for registry/composition; ToS derived exports own meaning
kag_provider.freshness: source export, derived seam, local manifest/index family, and compact provider records; runtime graph status remains downstream
kag_provider.next_organ: ToS derived-export owner -> local KAG validator -> aoa-kag registry/MCP consumer

generated_family.freshness: family digest, canonical generator check, family validator, and budget receipt

memo_port.consumer: tree-local candidate intake and the stronger aoa-memo memory owner
memo_port.load_moment: when reviewed evidence suggests a bounded memory candidate or owner handoff
memo_port.freshness: PORT.yaml, local route docs, candidate/receipt/export posture, and generated index; no claim of durable or live memory
memo_port.next_organ: candidate-only helper -> local validator -> reviewed aoa-memo intake/decision

negative_controls: generated view is not source
receipt is not source
ADR is not a substitute for unresolved authority
do not invent a taxonomy for a clear local contract
do not move authority while mapping boundaries
do not rewrite strong surfaces without pressure
do not widen into runtime or source authority
live or unreviewed evidence fails closed
diagnosis does not mutate
repair cannot mint authority
dry-run is not authorization
approval classification is not mutation
no hidden external write
local packet is not a verdict
advisory local route is not release authority
reference snapshot is not live
ratio is not philosophical or eval verdict
local provider is not runtime graph authority
generated record does not author ToS meaning
candidate is not durable memory
index is not a memory decision
receipt is not a claim

companion_surfaces.load_moment: triggered task asks for a worked shape

duplication_policy.observed_pressure: portable packages contain repeated reference schemas and logo assets
duplication_policy.local_action: preserve portable copies and verify their local routes
duplication_policy.negative_control: do not make a local shared copy or delete package-local portable assets
